_comment: /api/observe on open-licensed flood photos (Wikimedia Commons; CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA only, no NC/ND). Images are NOT stored in the repo: see `source` for each, with its licence and author. Run 2026-10-29 against Meta sam-3.1 + muse-spark-1.3 via dryrun.meta.observe.observe at 1280 px. Depths are model estimates with a stated band, not ground truth; null = the model declined to judge.

photos.title: File:FEMA - 32096 - Cars drives though flooded street in an Oklahoma neighborhood.jpg
photos.model_notes: Water covers roadway with bow waves at front wheels/bumper of cars. Level at lower tyre / bumper, below adult knee 0.5m, still passable for sedans.

photos.title: File:Flash-flood-cookevilletn1.jpg
photos.model_notes: Water covers lower half of car wheels, below sill, with bow wave from moving car. Tyre diameter ~0.65m suggests ~0.3m standing depth.

photos.title: File:Flood in Prague 2013, Vojenova street parking with car.JPG
photos.model_notes: Water partially submerges car tyres up to lower rim, just below sills; tyre diameter ~0.65m suggests ~0.2-0.3m depth at car.

photos.title: File:Flood waters rising (1178).jpg
photos.model_notes: Entire street inundated. Distant cars/van show water covering lower wheels approaching lower body, consistent with car tyre ~0.65m diameter indicating ~0.3-0.5m in roadway; water just reaching shop thresholds/door bases.

photos.title: File:Flooded road in Lagos.jpg
photos.model_notes: Standing water covers roadway; car tyres only partially submerged below hub, well below door sill; wakes behind vehicles in center distance indicate 10-30cm depth, with deeper ponding on right shoulder near barrier.

photos.title: File:Lekki flooding.jpg
photos.model_notes: Distant sedan in upper left standing in floodwater with waterline around lower bumper/bottom of doors, tyres mostly submerged. Compared to ~0.65m tyre diameter suggests ~0.3-0.6m depth. High uncertainty due to distance, low resolution, murky water and no close reference.

photos.title: File:Road Flooding and Water Erosion at Ichedi, Umudioka, Awka, Anambra State.jpg
photos.model_notes: Muddy sheet flow across road but no clear waterline on reference. Person is heavily blurred so knee/leg submergence cannot be seen. Door in background is above and away from water, not inundated. No tyre visible. Depth cannot be reliably judged.

photos.title: File:Street Flood.jpg
photos.model_notes: Water covers entire roadway and reaches lower half of sedan tyres and sills of cars and yellow auto-rickshaw. Using car tyre ~0.65m diameter, submersion to ~1/3-1/2 tyre indicates ~0.2-0.4m depth, best estimate ~0.3m.
